home_services.label: Home Services
home_services.positioning: Turn missed calls and estimate requests into booked jobs faster.

responses.new_inquiry: Thanks for reaching out to {company}. We can help with {service}. What address or ZIP code is the job in, and what would you like us to take a look at?
responses.quote_request: Absolutely. To give you the most useful estimate, please send the service needed, location, timing, and any photos or details you have. We’ll confirm the next best step.
responses.missed_call: Sorry we missed your call. This is {company}. What can we help you with today? Reply here with the service you need and your ZIP code and we’ll follow up.
responses.follow_up: Hi {first_name}, just checking back on your {service} request. If you still need help, I can get the next step lined up for you.
responses.review_request: Thanks for choosing {company}. If everything went well, would you mind leaving a quick review? It really helps a local business like ours.
responses.repeat_offer: Hi {first_name}, thanks again for working with {company}. If anything else comes up, we’re happy to help—and we can also schedule routine maintenance if useful.
responses.faq: We can help answer questions about service areas, scheduling, estimates, availability, and what to expect before the appointment.

salon_spa.label: Salon & Spa

responses.missed_call: Sorry we missed you at {company}. If you were calling to book, reply with the service you want and your preferred day/time and we’ll help from there.

responses.repeat_offer: Hi {first_name}, it may be time for your next visit. Want help finding a time for your usual service at {company}?
responses.faq: We can answer common questions about services, appointment timing, preparation, cancellation policies, and availability.
